text_array:
You wake up in a dark room. 
A glowing screen shows today's date - May 1st, 3137.
It has been 1111 years.

Memories flow in. You used to be a billionaire in the year of 2026. 
One night, being drunk with friends you decided to sign up for one of those programs. 
The ones where they would freeze your brain in hopes of resurrecting it in the future.

Suddenly, a woman in a white uniform enters the room. 
"What is the number?" she asks.
1. 1111
2. 15

choice_1:
You have angered her! 
The woman slowly and carefully pulls out a knife.
choice_2:
"What a sweetie! You sure know the binary system!"
The woman smiles kindly.

The nurse hands you a blue hospital gown.
"Wait, I was naked this entire time?" you think.

text_array:
The hospital air started to feel heavy, 
you decided to go for a walk outside.

You leave your room and enter the corridor. 
As your eyes adjust to the darkness, your bare feet feel cold and...
You try to step out of the wet puddle but your body is still weak after a 1111 year coma.

You slip and fall right into the puddle of blood. 
1. Get up and pretend like nothing happened 
2. Lick the blood

choice_1: Your body feels so heavy, but you get up and continue down the corridor.
choice_2:
You lick the puddle. Tastes metallic, as expected. 
You like the taste.
"Can't let this go to waste!" you think as your hands put droplets of blood into your pocket.

text_array:
Finally, you make it outside. Everything is green. 
Looks like you made it into the hospital's garden.

A mysterious girl approaches you. 
Her hair is snow white with bright red spots. 
Reminds you of the pattern you would see on a goldfish.

The girl speaks. 
"Hey, how do you make a NOT gate only using NAND gates? 
Show me an example with the variable 'a'. 
This is a test :)" 
1. A single gate: NAND(a=a, b=a, out=out) 
2. Two gates: NAND(a=a, b=b, out=ab_nand), NAND(a=ab_nand, b=ab_nand, out=out)

choice_1:
"Phewww!!! You totally scared me just now! 
Good to know you're a fellow human, but, seriously, 
do something about the blood stains on you."
Ah, yes, you forgot you were soaked in blood now after slipping into the blood puddle.
choice_2:
"Hm? Interesting. Could you solve this for me please?" 
The girl offers you a puzzle. 
Seems like you need to guess letters in this game...
